title: Chrome for founders on Mac: how to work faster with Lazur
metaTitle: Chrome for Founders on Mac: Optimize Your Workflow with Lazur
description: Learn how to use Chrome for founders on Mac more effectively. Manage tabs, automate research, and use Lazur to save hours of administrative work each week.
intro: You can master Chrome for founders on Mac by combining native shortcuts with the Lazur voice assistant. Founders often lose 36 percent of their workweek to administrative tasks, much of which happens inside a browser. Lazur sits in your Mac notch, waiting for you to hold a key to answer questions about your screen or perform research. This guide shows you how to reclaim your time while using Chrome to run your business.
tldr: Founders spend up to 36 percent of their time on administrative tasks, often trapped in browser tabs.
Use native Chrome shortcuts like ⌘ + T and ⌘ + Option + Right Arrow to navigate faster.
Lazur helps by answering questions about your screen, researching web topics, and guiding you through complex browser settings.
Keep your Mac workspace clean to reduce the mental load of constant context switching.
Lazur does not click buttons for you, but it points, explains, and researches to help you move faster.

blocks.text: Mastering Chrome keyboard shortcuts on Mac

The fastest way to use Chrome is to stop using your mouse for navigation. Founders who rely on their trackpad for every action lose seconds that add up to hours. Start by learning these core shortcuts. Use ⌘ + T to open a new tab instantly. Use ⌘ + L to jump to the address bar when you need to search or enter a URL. If you have many tabs open, use ⌘ + Option + Right Arrow to move to the next tab. Use ⌘ + 1 through ⌘ + 8 to jump directly to specific tabs.
Managing Chrome profiles for business and life

Context switching is a major productivity killer. Separation is your best defense. Create separate Chrome profiles for different parts of your business. Go to the profile icon in the top right corner and select Add. This keeps your personal bookmarks, saved passwords, and history away from your professional life. It prevents you from accidentally sharing the wrong screen during a call or seeing personal notifications while you are in deep work mode.
How Lazur helps founders in Chrome

Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It sees your screen when you hold ⌥ ⌘. You can ask it to explain a complex web page, find a specific setting in Chrome, or summarize a long article. If you need to research a competitor, ask Lazur to look into it. It uses its own Chrome tabs to gather information and returns a report to you. It does not click buttons, but it points to where you need to go.

items: Keeping too many tabs open without using tab groups. Right click a tab to add it to a new group.
Ignoring Chrome updates. Outdated browsers are slower and less secure.
Installing too many extensions. Every extension uses memory and can slow down your Mac.
Storing all passwords in the browser without a dedicated manager like 1Password.
Failing to clear cache and cookies when a site behaves strangely.

blocks.text: Founders spend a lot of time reading. Whether it is market research or competitor analysis, the volume of content is high. Instead of opening ten tabs and reading each one, hold the shortcut key and tell Lazur what you need to know. It will process the information and provide the key points. This allows you to stay focused on strategy rather than reading every word on every page.

Your environment matters. Use tools like Magnet or Rectangle to keep your browser windows organized. A cluttered screen leads to a cluttered mind. Keep your primary browser window in the center. Put your communication tools like Slack or email on a separate desktop space. Use ⌃ + Left Arrow or ⌃ + Right Arrow to switch between spaces. This keeps your focus on the task at hand.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me in Chrome?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons, fill out forms, or operate apps for you. It points to where you should click, explains how to do things, and answers your questions.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe for my business data?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen when you hold the shortcut key. Audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers to answer your request and are not stored. Your data is never used to train AI models.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is currently built for macOS only, supporting both Apple silicon and Intel chips.

faq.question: How do I update Chrome on my Mac?
faq.answer: Click the Chrome menu, select About Google Chrome, and the browser will automatically check for and install updates.
